children: UAE-based Azizi Developments has announced steady progress on its contemporary mixed-use community - Beach Oasis II - coming up in Dubai Studio City, with nearly 62% work already completed.
Once ready, it will feature 694 residences with a mix of studios, one- and two-bed units with other premium amenities.
Giving a project update, Azizi said the structural framework of the development is now 100% complete, with blockwork reaching 99% and internal plastering advancing to 77%.

HVAC and MEP installations currently stand at 59% and 50%, respectively, while overall finishes have progressed to 48%. Additionally, swimming pool construction stands at 38%, with elevator and façade works reaching 34% and 15%, respectively.

According to Azizi, Beach Oasis II boasts 452 studios, 209 one- and 33 two-bedroom residences along with a comprehensive suite of lifestyle amenities. Anchored by a large beach-like swimming pool in the central courtyard, the community includes fully equipped gymnasiums, landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, and a central square with integrated retail options for residents.

Speaking on the project, Group CEO Farhad Azizi said: "The heavy lifting is done. With the core structural works behind us, our focus has now shifted to MEP routing, plastering, and the interior finishes that actually make these spaces livable."
"It’s a precise, detail-oriented phase of construction, and it keeps our momentum exactly where it needs to be as we push toward the final handover," she stated.
Situated along Hessa Street near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Dubai Studio City offers excellent road connectivity and immediate access to key commercial, leisure, and sporting destinations.
Nearby landmarks include Dubai Autodrome, The Els Club, Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club, Dubai International Stadium, and Dubai Miracle Garden, alongside leading schools and healthcare facilities.

title: ZAWYA: Dubai's Azizi completes 62% of 694-unit residential project
